description: Diagnostic module to identify root cause of importlib failures in smoke tests for registry_api.py, rug_pull_monitor.py, signal_analyser.py. Checks: (1) Python sys.path entries missing workspace paths, (2) module-level import statements referencing protected files that no longer export expected names, (3) circular import chains in signal_analyser hierarchy. Uses importlib.util.find_spec and ast parsing to identify broken import statements without executing them. Reports findings as structured dict, does not modify files. Targeted at protected files — diagnostic only, no rewrites proposed.
